workersImport.heading: Import workers
workersImport.hint: CSV rows create public worker profiles with no app account. user_id stays empty — it is only set when someone signs up. Profiles appear on the map when they have coordinates (from postcode if lat/lng are blank).
workersImport.required: headline is required. Do not include id or user_id. contact_email, contact_phone, and linkedin_url are stored on the profile for contact reveal. skills and desired_job_types are pipe-separated. Defaults: visibility=public, availability=immediate, actively_looking=true.

businessesImport.heading: Import businesses
businessesImport.hint: CSV rows create public business profiles with no app account. They are saved as not actively hiring, and they still appear on the jobs map when they have coordinates. Uploading the same place id again updates that business.
businessesImport.required: name is required. A Google Places export works (id, name, url, phone, categories, address, lat, lng). id is the external place id, so the same business is not added twice. Actively hiring is always off.
